description_en: Removes IP addresses or CIDR blocks from the whitelist of a listener
kebab_example: aliyun slb remove-listener-white-list-item --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --load-balancer-id lb-8vb86hxixo8lvsja80000 --listener-port 80 --source-items 192.168.XX.XX --api-version 2014-05-15 --region cn-hangzhou
name: RemoveListenerWhiteListItem

parameters.help_en:
The region where the Classic Load Balancer (CLB) instance is created.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/27584.html operation to query the most recent region list
parameters.help_zh:
负载均衡实例的地域。

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/27584.html接口查询地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the CLB instance
parameters.name: load_balancer_id

parameters.help_en:
The list of IP addresses or CIDR blocks that you want to remove from the whitelist. Separate multiple IP addresses or CIDR blocks with commas (,).

If all IP addresses are removed from the whitelist, the listener does not forward requests
parameters.help_zh:
访问控制列表。支持输入IP地址或IP地址段（CIDR block形式），多个IP地址或地址段用逗号（,）分隔。

如果所有IP都被删除，则无法访问该监听
parameters.name: source_items

parameters.help_en:
The frontend protocol that is used by the CLB instance.

This parameter is required when listeners that use different protocols listen on the same port
parameters.help_zh:
负载均衡实例前端使用的协议。

相同端口存在不同协议监听时，此字段必填
parameters.name: listener_protocol
